title: The first site
body: Marc begins as a small contracting outfit in Ahilyanagar, building row houses on the Savedi side of the city. Six people, one site, one supervisor who is still with the firm.

title: Incorporated
body: The practice is incorporated as Madhumalati Constructions Pvt Ltd (CIN U45202MH1996PTC100650), formalising what had been a family business into a company with audited books.

title: First tower
body: The Courtyard takes Marc from three-storey walk-ups to a lift-served RCC tower, and sets the specification sheet the firm still builds to.

title: RERA and the register
body: Every project from here is registered with MahaRERA. Registration numbers go on the hoarding, the brochure and, later, the website.

title: Five sites, one city
body: Five projects under construction across Savedi, Nalegaon and Bhistabag; 100+ delivered addresses; 3,000+ families in Marc buildings.
